messages:
Maria (AE): Quick post-POC debrief — thanks team. Luma Bank execs want the readout deck by EOD tomorrow and a clear next-steps ask. Can we confirm final metrics and gaps?
Sam (SE): Putting numbers together now. Key highlights: end-to-end latency median 180ms, p95 310ms (during peak test), throughput ~120 req/s on Dedicated pool, avg token cost down 28% vs baseline.
Anya (Solutions Eng): On quality: eval set (10k prompts) pass rate 88% for acceptance criteria (we aimed 90%). Main failure modes: entity hallucinations and truncated long-context responses.
Drew (Eng): Truncation came from KV-cache eviction at 4k tokens. We can bump cache config, but cost ups ~12% or move to larger instance families. Also saw a couple of retry spikes from GC during the long-run test.
Priya (Security): Outstanding from security questionnaire: KMS key rotation detail, SOC2 appendix for Dedicated, and dataflow diagram for the Private deployment. Luma flagged need for customer-managed keys.
Sam (SE): For the readout slide: propose 1) Metrics snapshot (latency/throughput/cost/quality), 2) Gap list + mitigations, 3) POC timeline & ask (Dedicated commit + SOC docs), 4) Expansion path (embeddings + reranking).
Maria (AE): Good. Need one-liner executive ask: committed Dedicated pool 2x for production + 6-month discounted rate? price ask draft: 20% off list for 6-month commit. Thoughts?
Drew (Eng): Technical ask: enable 2x Dedicated for canary + warmup window, and a deploy schedule that avoids EOM spikes. We'll provide expected p95 under that config.
Anya (Solutions Eng): Mitigations for quality: 1) prompt templates + system message constraints, 2) add eval-based reranking and thresholding, 3) set up targeted prompt tests to lower hallucination below 2% within two weeks.
Sam (SE): Adding the eval snippet to the appendix:
```
Eval summary:
- prompts: 10,000 sampled
- pass@threshold: 0.9
- current pass: 0.88
- hallucination rate: 3.4%
```
Maria (AE): Priya, can we get the KMS / SOC docables by tomorrow noon? That’s a gating item for their legal/compliance review.
Priya (Security): I'll share the KMS plan and SOC2 extract by 11:30. For customer-managed keys we need a brief onboarding note — who owns infra changes at Luma?
Maria (AE): Point of contact is @luma-cloudops (they want SSO + IP allowlist).
Drew (Eng): We'll prepare a config template for customer-managed KMS + IP allowlist and a runbook for cutover; estimate 3 engineer-days to finalize.
Anya (Solutions Eng): For the quality gap, I'll deliver a prioritized prompt set and a reranking prototype by Tuesday EOD. That should push pass rate >90% in targeted flows.
Sam (SE): Pricing note: if they want 6-month commit, sales model can do tiered ramp: 1) month 1-2 50% capacity, 2) month 3+ full capacity. That reduces immediate cost pressure.
Maria (AE): Nice. For the readout deck I'll draft the exec ask and slide order. Can someone throw the final numbers + one-line risk statement by 4pm?
Sam (SE): I'll push updated metrics + the risk blurb by 3pm.
Priya (Security): Docs inbound 11:30. Also flag: they asked about audit logging retention — default 90 days, we can offer extended retention as an add-on.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-20 09:12:43 — canary rollout to dedicated-pool-2 succeeded :white_check_mark:
Maria (AE): Action items recap: Sam — final metrics + risk blurb (3pm); Anya — prompt set + reranker prototype (Tue EOD); Drew — KMS/IP template + runbook (3 engineer-days); Priya — KMS + SOC extract (11:30). Deck owner: Maria (I'll compile). Meeting: readout with Luma execs tomorrow 10:00am PT.
Drew (Eng): One more: I'll include cost delta table for bumping cache vs larger instance so they can see ops tradeoffs.
Anya (Solutions Eng): I'll also attach a short demo script for the readout to show before/after on the hallucination cases.
Maria (AE): Thanks team — let's keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
